authority.source: UrAi Generic World Library governed modular specification; generic exploration candidate

prompt: Original generic modular architecture-shell; one separable asset, not a whole environment. No real place/person, brands, logos, visible text, sci-fi, low-poly filler, floating parts or intersecting geometry. Physically plausible PBR, believable wear, correct UVs/normals; meter scale, +Y up, reusable grounded pivot. Clear central aisle 2.2 m, side aisles at least 1.2 m, double rear exit, flat front platform by default. Raised dais variants require an accessible alternative; no forced religious iconography. Target bounding dimensions 12m wide x 5.2m high x 16m deep. Materials: paint-warm-off-white. Clear passage where applicable; no arms/hands, forced characters or inaccessible hazards. GLB with embedded PBR textures. Generic exploration candidate only; visual/rights review required.
